case_name: National Insurance Company Limited vs Tsering Smanla
facts_of_case: A claim petition was filed by the respondent-claimant seeking compensation for an accident on 11.10.2013. The appellant had appeared and resisted the claim.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the claimant to establish a valid adoption.
legal_principles.held: Learned senior counsel submits that no adoption can be made after the commencement of the Act by or to a Hindu except in accordance with the provisions contained in Chapter II of the J&K Hindu Adoptions and Maintenance Act, 1960 now repealed.
applicable_acts_sections: J&K Hindu Adoptions and Maintenance Act, 1960 — Chapter II

legal_principles.principle: Tribunals have no power to award a panel rate of interest.
legal_principles.held: It has been held that the Tribunals have no power of awarding panel rate of interest.

outcome.final_order: The impugned award dated 09.10.2018 was set aside, and the claim petition was rejected.
